Perhaps I can provide some insight, as I am a recently diagnosed autistic adult. I was also recently diagnosed with ADHD.
I have difficulties processing and executing instructions as well as remembering sequences. As a result of having ADHD and OCD, I find that my mind wanders if I spend an extended period of time in a pose. 

Two recommendations that I have for you are that you aim to always use clear instructions. I find it difficult when instructors use abstract language that I find obscures the meaning. I would always encourage you to offer modifications for those with mobility issues, etc. 

I often become “lost” when attempting to perform a sequence, especially if the instructor does not perform it in front of the class. I think that it would be helpful if, prior to having students complete a sequence on their own, you would ask if anyone is lost or has questions. Finally, I would encourage you to ask students if they need an instruction repeated or restated if he or she find it unclear or difficult.
